open_points.subject: A01 rule 5 request-check precedence
open_points.text: A01 says “after the checks every request passes (A16 rule 1: size, token, depth, schema, actor)”, but A16 checks the request message’s depth before the operation schema and checks the depth of JSON texts carried as strings only after the request names a known operation and fits its schema.
open_points.question: Does A01’s newly inserted “depth” mean only the request message’s depth, or must every carried JSON text also pass its depth check before operation-schema validation?
options: Only the request message depth precedes schema validation; carried JSON-text depth remains after it as A16 specifies.
All depth checks precede operation-schema validation, changing A16’s stated order.
open_points.default_guess: Treat “depth” in A01’s summary as the request message depth only and preserve A16’s detailed order.
